episodes.title: How can my child learn about Indigenous Australia? - Ijoolleen koo waa'ee Abbootii Dachee Australia akkamiin barachuu danda'u - AE
episodes.description: Supporting your child’s connection with the world’s oldest continuing living culture is one of the greatest gifts you can offer them while raising them in Australia. But if you’re new to the country, you may be unsure where to begin. Here are some starting points and ideas to help you and your child learn about Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, cultures and history. - Walitti dhufeenya ijoolleen keessan aadaa addunyaa irratti turaa tahe akkasumas jiraataa fi itti fufiinsa qabu deeggaruun ijoollee keessan Australia keessatti guddachaa jiraniif kennaawwan gurugddaa kennuufii dandeessan keessaa isa tokko dha. Garuu yoo biyyattiif haaraa taatan eessaa akka eegaltan beekuu dhiisuu maltu. Ijoolleen keessan waa'ee aadaa fi seenaa ummattoota Abbootii Dachee fi Torres Strait Islander akka baraniif qabxiiilee fi yaaddan isin gargaaruu danda'an tokko tokko kunoo ti.
